name: consequential-analytics
title: Consequential Analytics
description: Consequential's own MCP server. Lets Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants query a Consequential workspace's marketing analytics in plain language: workspaces, the metric catalog, business metrics, acquisition performance, daily history and BFCM forecasting. Read-only and scoped to the workspaces the signed-in account can access.

authentication.note: Sign in with a Consequential account (app.consequential.io) and approve the consent screen.
